metadata.description: Simple, general-purpose agent skills, one plugin per skill

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Prepare a handoff prompt for another agent session or a colleague: clipboard by default, a file on request, or a zip with a patch and the material the recipient cannot reach.

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Summarize a reply in a few bullets (decisions, open questions, next actions) and optionally keep a TLDR footer on later replies.

plugins.name: init-agents-md
plugins.description: Create a short, repository-specific AGENTS.md for coding agents and make CLAUDE.md a symlink to it.

plugins.name: port-to-codex
plugins.description: Port a project's Claude Code setup to Codex: one shared AGENTS.md with CLAUDE.md linked to it, and skills, agents, MCP and hooks converted with rulesync, committed or regenerated on setup.

plugins.name: gemini-web-research
plugins.description: Delegate web research to parallel Gemini jobs through the agy CLI; a script checks every claim's quote against the pages each job actually read.

plugins.name: codex-image-gen
plugins.description: Generate or edit images through the codex CLI's built-in image tool, on the Codex login's quota and with no API key.

plugins.name: google-image-gen
plugins.description: Generate or edit images through the Google Gemini API with your own API key.
